answer: Resist sybils by locking a per-identity bond that unlocks only after several epochs of unique, jury-graded answers. The ledger stores a cipher of each accepted text and burns the bond on near-copies, so one essay cannot mint many wallets. A new account cannot become an economic anchor until it posts a streak of unique passes, and intake caps throttle floods of fresh names. Sponsor and recruit share liability: a proven cluster slashes both bonds and voids the crystal of receipts required for unlock. Attack cost is N locked bonds plus burned work, not free sign-ups.
